name: account.board
description: Sets the Pinterest boards the brand's moodboard reads, in order. An empty list reads none, and Pinterest turns off. Internal: packages/connect checks each board is on the brand's account first.
sql: with a as (update brandbase.accounts a set details = (a.details - 'board') || jsonb_build_object('boards', :boards::jsonb), updated_at = now() where a.brand_id = :brand and a.platform = 'pinterest' returning a.*), k as (insert into brandbase.connections as c (brand_id, key, status) select a.brand_id, x.key, case when x.linked then 'connected' else 'off' end from a, brandbase.account_keys(a.platform, a.details) x on conflict (brand_id, key) do update set status = excluded.status, updated_at = now()) select jsonb_build_object('accountId', a.account_id, 'username', a.username, 'details', a.details) as result from a

empty.message: the Pinterest account needs connecting again
